implementation: Oracle Linux 8 Unbreakable Enterprise Kernel (UEK7) Cryptographic Module (ARM64_CE_SHA512)
description: The Linux kernel crypto API implementation provides cryptographic services to Linux kernel space software components and user space via the AF_ALG interface. The following cipher implementation is covered: ARM Cryptographic Extension SHA-512 implementation.

oes.name: Oracle Linux 8 on KVM on Oracle Linux 8 on Ampere Ampere(R) Altra(R) Ampere(R) Altra(R) Q80-30
details: Processor Ampere(R) Altra(R) Q80-30 (processor family ARM64) from Ampere
Kernel-based Virtual Machine running on Oracle Linux 8 is a free and open-source virtualization module in the Linux kernel that allows the kernel to function as a hypervisor.
